**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
[The Clever Woman of the Family](../books.html#58) as far as she goes will be sent you in a day or two from a friend who had had her to read.

The [illustrations](../others.html#167) are decidedly not successful and I should not wish to perpetuate them.

They are not half so good as what [Miss Keary](../persons.html#793)’s young [cousin](../persons.html#887) does.[^1]
There is about a fourth more of the story to come.
I have nearly finished the [Golden Deeds](../books.html#51), but alas the Lotty story has eluded me twice again.

However I have quite enough for the pages.

Yours very truly
C. M.

Yonge

[^1]: Katie Johns, who was related to the novelist Annie Keary (1825-1879).
